arguments.title: Palette-based Photo Recoloring
key_claims: The method uses a small editable palette, perceptual color space and gamut-aware transformations with monotonic luminance. This suggests retaining multiple palette components and testing their allocation to fixtures. Its video extension uses one frame palette throughout a sequence and explicitly notes long-sequence limitations. Image-space recoloring and its user study do not validate DMX rendering or music fit. The discussion notes that simple color distances can misrank visible artifacts; retain human inspection and temporal/brightness guards alongside numerical reconstruction.
